title: Normalized constant-scalar realization for Brown coefficient projection
statement: Let $O$ be a commutative ring, $t\in O$, and $A_n=O/(t^{n+1})$ for $n\ge0$. Use the small-etale strict coefficient levels and evaluation packages of [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces] and the ordinary and universal derived geometric image packages of [def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data]. Define the normalized realization interface at a scheme $W$ as follows. Its ordinary functor is the restriction to constant scalars of [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data], applied to $A_n$. Its derived functor $R_{W,n}:D(\operatorname{Mod}(\underline A_n))\to D(W_{et},A_n)$ is an equivalence with the specified exact-localization factorization. For every $m\le n$, scalar restriction has an identity-on-sections comparison with this realization; its derived comparison is fixed by its localization square on every cochain representative. The derived scalar-extension comparison is its adjunction mate, using the given scalar adjunction and the ordinary fixed-ring derived scalar adjunction. For a scheme morphism $g:V\to W$ and a given ordinary/derived image package, define the normalized image realization interface: the ordinary right-image comparison is the recorded underlying set-sheaf comparison on every section; the derived right-image comparison satisfies the square with the given universal right-derived unit and the standard right-derived unit on every cochain representative; the inverse-image comparison is its adjunction mate. The interfaces assert no existence, projection invertibility, finite-coefficient condition, or condition on $t$.
